name: New Jersey (DGE) Market Profile

regulator.name: New Jersey Division of Gaming Enforcement (DGE)
regulator.notes: Licensing co-regulator: NJ Casino Control Commission, https://www.nj.gov/casinos

minimum.notes: 83% theoretical RTP for each slot machine game requiring a wager. Skill-based games under 13:69E-1.28Y are EXEMPT from a minimum theoretical RTP. WHETHER THE 83% FLOOR APPLIES TO INTERNET SLOTS VIA 13:69O WAS NOT CONFIRMED - this is the key open question for an online product.

selfExclusion.nationalScheme: New Jersey Casino Gambling Self-Exclusion Program
selfExclusion.notes: Separately selectable for land-based casinos/sports facilities, internet gaming/sports wagering, or both. A product must not assume a single combined list.

requirement.value: Internet gaming computer equipment must be located in Atlantic City / New Jersey so that wagers are deemed placed there

recentChanges.change: NJ Governor's Responsible Gaming Task Force final report issued, covering online casino, sweepstakes, event-based contracts and skill-based wagering as under-regulated areas
recentChanges.notes: Signals likely future tightening for online casino. Worth reading as a forward indicator.

verificationRequired: Whether the 83% floor applies to internet slot games via 13:69O - highest priority for online products

consultantNotes: New Jersey is a mature US online casino market but its published technical constraints are thin relative to the UK or Ontario. Expect substantive requirements in the DGE technical standards document set and in licence conditions rather than in the code chapters.
The 2025 Responsible Gaming Task Force report is a forward indicator: plan for online casino RG requirements to tighten.
